    'Nanhe nanhe jo dekhungi bistar': 'Nanhe nanhe jo dekhuṅ gi bistar',
    'Saamne maa ke tum mar gaye ho': 'Saamne maaṅ ke tum mar gaye ho',
    'Eid jab jab bhi aayegi bachoṅ': 'Eid jab jab bhi aaye gi bachoṅ',
    'Khun maa ko rulayegi bachoṅ': 'Khun maaṅ ko rulaaye gi bachoṅ',
    'Dil pe chal jayega mere khanjar': 'Dil pe chal jaaye ga mere khanjar',
    'Chote hote musalle tumhare': 'Chhote hote musalle tumhaare',
    'Aankheiṅ ashkoṅ se ho jayengi tar': 'Aaṅkheiṅ ashkoṅ se ho jaayengi tar',
    'Khuoṅ meiṅ dube tumhare amaame': 'Khuṅ meiṅ dube tumhaare amaame',
    'Khaaungi ghash bapa hoga mehshar': 'Khaauṅ gi ghash bapaa ho ga mahshar',
    'Har qadam jaan khoti rahungi': 'Har qadam jaan khoti rahuṅ gi',
    'Umr bhar sirf roti rahungi': 'Umr bhar sirf roti rahuṅ gi',
    'Dil meiṅ dono ka gham hai barabar': 'Dil meiṅ donoṅ ka gham hai baraabar',
    'Khuṅ meiṅ dube tumhare janaze': 'Khuṅ meiṅ dube tumhaare janaaze',
    'Meri nazroṅ meiṅ aa kar rahegne': 'Meri nazroṅ meiṅ aa kar raheṅ ge',
    'Kis tarha bhuluṅ gham ka wo manzar': 'Kis tarah bhuluṅ gham ka wo manzar',
    'Dasht e ghurbat meiṅ tashna dahan the': 'Dasht-e-ghurbat meiṅ tashna dahan the',
    'Mamu ki tarha tum bekafan the': 'Maamu ki tarah tum bekafan the',
    'Qabr tak tum ko royegi maadar': 'Qabr tak tum ko roye gi maadar',
    'Kya hilaal ab likhe gham ka manzar': 'Kya Hilaal ab likhe gham ka manzar',
    'Sajid aale nabi meiṅ tha mehshar': 'Saajid Aal-e-Nabi meiṅ tha mahshar',
    'Bain karti thi ye binte hyder': 'Bain karti thi ye Bint-e-Haidar',
}
assert fixes.keys() <= {line[2:] for line in lines}
updated = '\\n'.join('  ' + fixes.get(line[2:], line[2:]) for line in lines)
source_lines = body.decode().strip().splitlines()
assert len(source_lines) == len(lines)
assert lines[0].strip() == '1' and source_lines[0] == '۱'
assert updated.count('Yaad aao ge Aun o Muhammad') == source_lines.count('یاد آؤ گے عون و محمد')

assert all(c.isascii() or c == 'ṅ' for c in updated)
p.write_bytes(head + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + updated.encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body)
print(f'Checked {len(lines) - 1} verse lines')

('Khuoṅ','Khuṅ'),('Khaaungi','Khaauṅ gi'),('bapa hoga','bapaa ho ga'),('mehshar','mahshar'),
('rahungi','rahuṅ gi'),('dono ka','donoṅ ka'),('barabar','baraabar'),('janaze','janaaze'),
('rahegne','raheṅ ge'),('tarha ','tarah '),('Dasht e ghurbat','Dasht-e-ghurbat'),
('Mamu','Maamu'),('royegi','roye gi'),('hilaal','Hilaal'),
('Sajid aale nabi','Saajid Aal-e-Nabi'),('binte hyder','Bint-e-Haidar')]:

    roman=roman.replace(before,after)

p.write_bytes(head+b'romanLyrics: |-\\n'+roman.encode()+b'\\n---\\n'+body)
print(f'{len(lines)-1} verse lines')
